capabilities: Open .html and .htm files as rendered previews in a dedicated view
Toggle scripts on or off per file with remembered permission
View HTML source with syntax highlighting and line numbers
Sandbox rendering with forms, popups, and navigation blocked
Refresh the preview after file changes
disambiguation: Views local .html and .htm files already stored in the vault, not live web pages.
extras: Scripts are disabled by default and enabled per file path; the README warns to enable them only for trusted files, since permission applies to future edits at the same path.
problem: Obsidian does not render local .html and .htm files stored in the vault, so exported reports, dashboards, and generated pages cannot be inspected without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: informed by the existing Obsidian HTML viewer ecosystem, including the MIT-licensed JiaLinZhang24/obsidian-html-viewer

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .html and .htm files as sandboxed rendered pages or syntax-highlighted source inside Obsidian.
